ui.record.clip_title: The input reached full scale and may have clipped: lower the gain on the interface. Click to clear.
ui.record.stop_confirm: Stop recording? Press again to stop ({seconds} s)
ui.record.stop_keys: Space or the button. Esc only hides this view; the take goes on.
ui.record.stopping: Stopping and putting the take on the timeline…
ui.record.indicator_title: A take is recording. Click to show the record view and stop it there.
ui.record.elsewhere: Another project is recording ({take}). Stop it there first.
ui.record.no_devices: No input found. Connect an interface or a microphone.
ui.record.loading: Asking the recorder for the inputs…
ui.record.imported_interrupted: {take} was interrupted; everything recorded is on the timeline.

ui.record.imported_gaps.one: {take} is on the timeline with {count} gap where nothing could be recorded.
ui.record.imported_gaps.other: {take} is on the timeline with {count} gaps where nothing could be recorded.

ui.record.pending.one: {count} recorded take was never put on the timeline (the editor or the recorder stopped mid-take).
ui.record.pending.other: {count} recorded takes were never put on the timeline (the editor or the recorder stopped mid-take).

ui.record.unload_warning: A take is recording. It goes on if you close this page.
error.record.no_playback: Nothing plays while a take records: listen through your audio interface.
error.record.armed_mismatch: The recorder is listening to another input or channel. Choose the input and channel again, then press Record.
record.event.disarmed: The input stopped, so the recorder stopped listening for the pre-roll. Nothing was recorded; check the input.
cmd.record.preroll: Pre-roll before recording: off / 10 s / 30 s / 60 s / 2 min
cmd.record.preroll.hint: Switches how many seconds before you press Record are included in the take. While the record view is open the input is listened to and the last seconds are kept in memory only; nothing is written until you press Record.
ui.slow.info: Slow listening: hold Shift+J (backward) or Shift+L (forward). It plays only while the key is held.
ui.record.armed: Armed: listening, not recording. The last {seconds} s are kept in memory only; nothing is written until you press Record.
ui.record.armed_off: Pre-roll is off: the take starts when you press Record.
ui.record.preroll_included: Includes {seconds} s from before you pressed Record.
record.event.channel_failed: Channel {name} stopped recording. What it recorded so far is saved; the other channels go on.
error.record.same_track: Two channels cannot be recorded onto the same track. Give each channel its own track.
ui.record.no_channel: Choose at least one channel to record.
ui.record.imported_failed: {take} is on the timeline, but {names} stopped recording early. What it recorded is there.
error.record.old_recorder: The recorder that is running is older than this editor and is recording, so it was left alone and the take goes on. Pre-roll needs the newer recorder, which starts by itself after this take ends.
error.colab.not_signed_in: Colab is not signed in to Google yet. Use "Sign in to Google for Colab" first; the transcription starts after that.
error.colab.signin_failed:
The Google sign-in did not finish (exit code {code}).
{tail}
error.colab.signin_bad_code: That does not look like the code Google shows: it is one word without spaces. Copy it again from the Google page.
error.colab.signin_not_running: No Google sign-in is waiting for a code. Start the sign-in again.
cmd.app.colab_signin: Sign in to Google for Colab…
cmd.app.colab_signin.hint: Colab needs a Google sign-in once. This opens Google's sign-in page in the browser, takes the code it shows and checks that the sign-in worked. Nothing is uploaded.
ui.colab.signin_title: Sign in to Google for Colab
ui.colab.signin_text: Colab needs you to sign in to Google once. kuulas opens Google's sign-in page in your browser: sign in there, copy the code Google shows and paste it below. Nothing is uploaded, and no transcription starts, until you are signed in.
ui.colab.signin_waiting: Waiting for the code. If the browser did not open, open this address:
ui.colab.signin_ok: Signed in to Google. Colab transcription can start.
ui.colab.signin_state_yes: Signed in to Google for Colab.
ui.colab.signin_state_no: Not signed in to Google for Colab.
cmd.help.performance_report.hint: When kuulas is slow: record what it is doing for 10 to 60 seconds and save a text file you can send to the developer
cmd.help.log_debug.hint: Write everything kuulas does to the log file; use it when something goes wrong and you are asked for the log
cmd.help.log_info.hint: Write the usual events to the log file (the default)
cmd.help.log_warning.hint: Write only problems to the log file; the file stays small
ui.loglevel.now: Log level: {level}. Remembered for next time.
ui.perf.title: Record a performance report
ui.perf.intro: Use this while kuulas is slow, for example while a long project plays. It watches what the program is busy with and saves a text file next to the log. The file holds no project names, no file names and no text from your recordings.
ui.perf.running: Recording… {n} seconds left. Keep doing what is slow.
ui.perf.done: Saved in {folder} ({samples} samples) and shown in Finder. Send the .txt file.
ui.perf.toast_done: Performance report saved in {folder}. Send the .txt file.
cmd.view.language_auto.hint: Use the system's language for the screen and for kuulas's messages; remembered for you
cmd.view.language_fi.hint: Show kuulas in Finnish, whatever the system's language is; remembered for you
cmd.view.language_en.hint: Show kuulas in English, whatever the system's language is; remembered for you
ui.language.failed: The language could not be saved: {error}
cmd.app.close_project.hint: Closes this project and goes back to the start page. Nothing is lost: every edit is already saved. It will not close while a recording is running or the microphone is armed for pre-roll; a transcription that is running carries on by itself.
cmd.app.preferences.hint: Your settings in one place: language, how a recording is stopped, pre-roll, whether re-sync asks first, the clipboard preview level and the fast listening speed, with buttons to the Colab, automixer and keyboard shortcut settings. Each one is also in its own menu.
cmd.app.minimise.hint: Puts the kuulas window away in the Dock.
cmd.app.clear_recent.hint: Empties File > Open Recent and the start page's list of recent projects. The projects themselves are not touched.
ui.prefs.title: Preferences
ui.project.close_recording: A recording is running. Stop it before closing the project.
ui.project.close_armed: The microphone is listening for pre-roll. Close the record view first, then close the project.
ui.project.close_desktop_only: Close project works in the kuulas window. In a browser, close the tab.
ui.project.close_failed: The project could not be closed: {error}
ui.project.recent_cleared: The list of recent projects is empty.
ui.project.recent_missing: That project is not there any more: {path}
ui.window.minimise_desktop_only: Minimise works in the kuulas window only.
error.silence.bad_option: The Auto-Silence option {name} is not valid: {value}
error.silence.no_hand_mutes: Compensated for bleed learns from your own mutes, and this project has none. Mute some stretches by hand in the first minutes, then try again.
cmd.app.auto_silence_options.hint: Choose how strictly Auto-Silence closes the microphones, see what it would close per track, then apply it as one undo step. The choice is remembered for this project, and Auto-Silence (Alt+Mod+P) uses it.
cmd.gate.open_all: Open all gates on this track
cmd.gate.open_all.hint: Opens every closed stretch of the current track at once (clears its gate). One undo step.
ui.gate.all_open: All gates on this track are open.
ui.silence.title: Auto-Silence options
ui.silence.margin_hint: Lower = gentler: fewer stretches closed. A microphone counts as talking when it is this many dB above its own noise.
ui.silence.dominance_hint: How many dB below the loudest microphone another one may be and still count as talking at the same time. Change it and press Preview to see the effect.
ui.silence.method_hint: Compensated for bleed learns how much each microphone normally hears of the others from your own mutes in the first minutes, and opens a microphone only when it beats the others by more than that.
ui.silence.method_needs_mutes: Compensated for bleed needs your own mutes to learn from. Mute some stretches by hand in the first minutes to use it.
ui.silence.min_closed_hint: Pauses shorter than this stay open.
ui.silence.min_open_hint: Speech shorter than this between two closed stretches is closed too.
ui.silence.preview_row: {name}: would close {close} s in {stretches} stretches (now: {now} s)
log.offload.fallback: The analysis worker could not be started ({error}); measuring in the editor instead.
log.offload.inline: Analysis {task} running in the editor process (worker unavailable).
log.offload.killed: The analysis worker was killed ({code}); probably the system ran out of memory. Not repeating the analysis in the editor.
error.offload.crashed: The analysis process stopped without an answer ({exit}). If the computer was short of memory, close other programs. It is not retried at once.
error.offload.backoff: The analysis failed a moment ago; it is tried again in {seconds} s.
error.offload.busy: Too much analysis is waiting; try again in a moment.
error.offload.timeout: The analysis took longer than {seconds} s and was stopped.
log.offload.swept: Stopped {count} analysis workers left behind by an earlier run.
error.offload.memory: The analysis needed {mb} MB of memory, more than its limit of {limit_mb} MB, and was stopped so the computer does not slow down. Please report this with the log.
log.memory.high: The editor holds {mb} MB of memory (warning above {limit_mb} MB); cache budget {cache_mb} MB, largest analysis worker {worker_mb} MB.
error.music_level.bad_offset: Music under speech must be a number of dB between {low} and {high}.
error.music_level.no_music: There is no music to level: no unmuted music track has clips. Make a track a music track first (Track > Cycle track kind).
error.music_level.no_speech: There is no speech to level the music against: no unmuted speech track has talk in it.
error.music_level.stale: The edit changed after the measurement. Measure again, then apply.
cmd.app.music_level.hint: Measures the speech while someone is speaking and the loudest 3 seconds of the music, then sets the music tracks' gain so the music sits the chosen distance under the speech (default 10 dB). The music tracks keep their balance. One undo step; running it again gives the same gain.
ui.music_level.title: Set music level
ui.music_level.offset_hint: Where the loudest 3 seconds of the music sit against the speech. -10 keeps the music clearly under the voice; the automixer's own rule is +1.
ui.music_level.measuring: Measuring the speech and the music…
ui.music_level.bed: Loudest 3 s of the music: {lufs} LUFS (without the track gain)
ui.music_level.result_one: Apply sets the music track's gain to {gain} dB.
ui.music_level.result_many: Apply sets the loudest music track's gain to {gain} dB; the others keep their balance.
ui.music_level.clamped: Some music tracks reached the gain limit, so the music is not quite where asked.
cmd.bus.role_speech.hint: Sets the bus's role to speech and gives every track on it that role, in one undo step.
cmd.bus.role_music.hint: Sets the bus's role to music and gives every track on it that role, in one undo step.
cmd.bus.role_none.hint: Clears the bus's role. The tracks on it keep their own role.
cmd.bus.reapply_role.hint: Gives every track on the bus the bus's role again, in one undo step.
cmd.track.match_role.hint: Gives the current track the role of its bus.
ui.edit.label.reapply_role: Apply bus role to all tracks
ui.track.role_differs: Role differs from the bus ({role}); click to match
ui.bus.role_partial: Not all tracks on this bus have this role ({differ} of {total} differ)
error.edit.no_bus_role: That bus has no role to follow.
cmd.track.role_speech.hint: Makes the current track speech by hand; it stops following its bus's role.
cmd.track.role_music.hint: Makes the current track music by hand; it stops following its bus's role.
ui.track.role_match_none: Match bus role (the track has no bus with a role)
error.block_level.no_speech: There is no speech to level: no unmuted speech track has clips.
error.block_level.stale: The edit changed after the measurement. Measure again, then apply.
cmd.app.block_level.hint: Finds the blocks of each speaker's speech (between pauses) whose level is off, and lists them with the gain that would bring them back. Apply splits the clips in the pauses and adds the gain to the clips, so you can still adjust it. Very loud short spots are listed, not changed. One undo step; running it again changes nothing.
ui.block_level.title: Level blocks
ui.block_level.rule: Blocks more than {threshold} dB off the speaker's own level are levelled: cuts up to {cut} dB, boosts up to {boost} dB.
ui.block_level.row: {start}–{end}: {deviation} dB off its level, gain {gain} dB
ui.block_level.speaker: {name}
ui.block_level.left: {count} other blocks are within {threshold} dB and are left alone.
ui.block_level.clamped: Some clips reached the gain limit, so a block is not quite at its level.
ui.block_level.left_out: Blocks you left out are not marked as done: the automixer will still level them.
ui.automix.done_text_block: You levelled the speech blocks in Kuulas, so the automixer is told to skip its own block levelling. Reset to let the automixer do it.
ui.automix.done_stale_block: The speech blocks were levelled earlier in Kuulas, but the clips have changed since.
ui.automix.done_text_duck: Music ducking is already written into the music tracks' automation, so the automixer skips its own ducking. Reset to let the automixer do it.
ui.automix.done_stale_duck: Music ducking was written earlier in Kuulas, but a music curve or clip has changed since.
cmd.app.duck_music.hint: Measures when anyone speaks and writes editable ducking automation on each enabled music track. One undo step.
error.music_duck.stale: The edit changed after the measurement. Run Duck music under speech again.
